new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: This source gives a compact criterion for distinguishing a real regime-shaping shock from mere inconvenience: the point is to create a spectacle. It connects 9/11-style imagery, the Charlie Kirk event, Patriot-Act-sequel expectations, and war-pretext logic, but it is sensitive and needs comparison before public use.

First compare with the already-held trauma-programming seed from Capital of Evil and with Mass Society domestic-control evidence.

new_lens_seeds.title: Sacred Story As History Model
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: History becomes predictive when a sacred story is treated as a model: outcomes reveal hidden variables, beliefs assign roles, and committed actors try to make the story true.

Much of this already lives across Eschatology, Stories, Power, and Prediction, so the seed should remain a comparison family unless those pages need a shared method bridge.
